_comment: Sourced from https://hh-specs.handhistory.org/ (spec_version 1.4.9, fetched 2026-11-04). Exact strings and descriptions, not paraphrased. See

values.Preflop: Before any community cards are dealt
values.Flop: After the first three community cards
values.Showdown: Cards are shown to determine the winner

street.notes: Not unique within a hand's rounds array: a run-it-twice hand has two Flop rounds (etc.) sharing the same street name. round_obj.id gives the real order, not array position or street name.

values.Dealt Cards: Cards were dealt to a player (hole cards)
values.Mucks Cards: A player mucked (did not show) their cards
values.Shows Cards: A player showed their cards, typically at showdown
values.Post SB: A player posted the small blind
values.Post BB: A player posted the big blind
values.Post Dead: A player posted a dead blind
values.Post Extra Blind: A player posted an extra blind
values.Bet: A player bet. Not valid preflop, per the spec's own note.
values.Added Chips: A player added chips to their stack (cash game top-up)
values.Sits Down: A player sat down at the table
values.Stands Up: A player stood up from the table
values.Add to Pot: Chips added to the pot not tied to a specific player; player_id may be omitted or null for this action
values.Player Adjustment: A manual adjustment to a player's stack; amount may be negative

action.notes: The spec warns 'Bet' is not a valid preflop action (players Check or Raise instead, since there is already a live bet from the blinds).

currency.format: ISO 4217 three-letter code, plus OHH-specific non-ISO extensions for play money / site coin
currency.notes: The spec's own examples (XPM, XSC) are not real ISO 4217 codes. A validator must allow known extensions in addition to the real ISO 4217 list, not just the ISO list alone.

values.Run_It_Twice: Two or more sets of board cards are used in the play of the same hand (also used for three-or-more-times run-it)
values.Anonymous: The players at the table are all anonymous and have no specified name/ID for historical records
values.Observed: The hand was observed and the hero was not dealt into the hand
values.Fast: Fast poker game: any fast-fold variant where folding immediately moves you to the next hand
values.Cap: A game that limits the amount each player can wager per hand
values.Bomb_Pot: A hand with extra money in the pot that goes directly to the flop with no preflop action

hand_flags.notes: Array field on the hand object. Can be omitted, null, or an empty array if there are no flags.

values.DON: Double or nothing: half the players win double their buy-in, half win nothing
values.Bounty: Players are awarded prizes for knocking out specific players
values.Shootout: Multi-table tournament played in stages; each table plays to one remaining player, winners advance
values.Rebuy: Players may rebuy stacks of chips (various forms/timing/limits); rebuy-only-on-felt tournaments should use Re-Entry instead
values.Matrix: One buy-in split between multiple games; prize pool partly per-game, partly on aggregate placing
values.Push_Or_Fold: Every hand requires fold or push all-in
values.Satellite: Prize includes entry into another tournament
values.Steps: Steps tournament: players incrementally gain seats to additional, greater-value tournaments
values.Deep: Deep stack tournament: starting stacks are more big blinds than a normal starting stack
values.Multi-Entry: Players can have more than one entry into the same tournament, not synonymous with Rebuy
values.Fifty50: Fifty percent of players win a prize; all winners get a base prize plus an amount based on remaining chips when half the field is eliminated
values.Flipout: Players' hands are all played face up without betting rounds
values.TripleUp: A third of the players win three times their buy-in, the rest win nothing
values.Lottery: Fast action games with accelerated blind timings and shorter stacks; prize is randomly chosen before the game begins
values.Re-Entry: A player can re-enter a tournament after being felted
values.Power_Up: Three-person game with special 'powers' not typically possible in table games
values.Progressive-Bounty: Like Bounty, but bounty winning amounts can vary, usually half to the hand winner and half added to the winner's own bounty

tournament_flags.notes: Array field on tournament_info_obj. Can be omitted, null, or an empty array if there are no flags.
